# Graph operations · array

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### array.broadcast



Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `arrays` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `mode` | `string` | Required | {"choices":["zip","cycle","hold","cartesian","cartesianReverse"]} |
| Input | `limit` | `number` | `100000` | {"finite":true,"min":1,"max":100000,"integer":true} |
| Output | `value` | `array<record>` | — | {"items":"record"} |

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#array-operations)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe array.broadcast --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### array.mapById



Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.
